meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 比较当前代码与最新发布的 npm 版本,读取实际 diff 而非直接抄提交信息,用平实语言说明每项改动的真实内容与影响;按三个发布层分类,输出分层影响矩阵和各层版本升级建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到「unpublished changes」「changelog」「what changed」等关键词,或要求查看未发布更改、生成变更日志时触发。

say.text: 看看有没有未发布的更改
say.note: 触发技能,对比当前与最新 npm 版本。
按发布层列出改动并给出版本建议。

say.text: 对比 HEAD 和最新版 npm 包有什么变化
say.note: 执行实际 diff 分析。

howto.what_en: Compares HEAD with latest published npm versions, reads actual diffs, describes real changes, classifies into release layers, and outputs a layered impact matrix plus version bump suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', or when the user asks to see unpublished changes / generate a changelog.

say_en.note: Runs the skill against the latest npm versions.
Lists changes by release layer with version bumps.

say_en.text: Compare HEAD with latest npm package versions.
